answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 15226 Country: Canada Title: Dear Brother, Assalamualaikum, If vomiting happens during fasting, will the fast broken? Jazakallah Khair. Question: Dear Brother, Assalamualaikum, If vomiting happens during fasting, will the fast broken? Jazakallah Khair. Answer ID: 15226 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1289/1031=L/1430) During sawm (fasting), the sawm is nullified by vomiting mouthful, but if one vomits unintentionally the sawm will not be nullified. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
